event.description: The first Ascent in Southern California, featuring Alchemical Revolution! Come out to play and hangout with GA fans from all over the world. Meet special guests Hanh Chu and Gyool and win exclusive merchandise at the Ascent Store. The event is free for spectator, but the main tournament and all side events are ticketed events which can be purchased here: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/grand-archive-tcg-ascent-ontario-2024-tickets-758337717527?aff=oddtdtcreator
